motivation.primaryCryptoEvidence: Han, Kang, and Ryu, Momentum in the Cryptocurrency Market: A Comprehensive Analysis under Realistic Assumptions, SSRN 4675565, revised 2026-03-26
motivation.supportingCryptoEvidence: Liu and Tsyvinski, Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency, Review of Financial Studies 34(6), 2021
motivation.riskManagementEvidence: Barroso and Santa-Clara, Momentum has its moments, Journal of Financial Economics 116(1), 2015
motivation.designReason: Recent realistic-assumption evidence favors time-series over cross-sectional crypto momentum. The candidate deliberately lowers turnover, avoids leverage and shorting, and scales exposure only downward when realized volatility is high.

signal.decisionTiming: first available UTC daily candle whose date is the first day of a calendar month; signal uses only closes strictly before that candle and execution uses that candle open
signal.longRule: at least two of the three exact-lookback simple returns are strictly positive
signal.strengthRule: two positive horizons targets two-thirds of the per-asset cap; three positive horizons targets the full per-asset cap

risk.volatilityRule: multiply the momentum target weight by min(1, targetAnnualizedVol / trailingAnnualizedVol); volatility may only reduce exposure

comparators: BTC-USD 15% buy-and-hold with identical entry/exit cost
equal 15% BTC-USD/ETH-USD/SOL-USD buy-and-hold with identical entry/exit cost
unscaled version of the exact same monthly momentum signal
gate: candidate net return after costs is positive over the full 2022-2025 development window
candidate has positive net return in at least three of four calendar-year folds
candidate maximum drawdown is no worse than the unscaled momentum comparator
candidate turnover is reported in full and no missing daily lookback is interpolated
development.failureRule: If the development gate fails, Trial 5 is recorded as failed and no parameter rescue is permitted under tsmom-v1.

retrospectiveDiagnostic.purpose: diagnostic only; cannot authorize promotion because this period predates the Trial 5 freeze

requirements: at least 180 calendar days of post-freeze data beginning no earlier than 2026-08-19
positive net return after frozen costs
maximum drawdown below 15% of starting equity
no data provenance, exact-lookback, timestamp, or overwrite gate failure
all results reported alongside the frozen live/paper v2 result over the same prospective dates before any promotion proposal
